title: RoboHarness: A Simple Harness Outperforms VLA and World Actions Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has opened a path toward generalist embodied AI, raising the question of how LLMs can act in the physical world. One straightforward approach is training the model to generate actions: collect robot-action data and video demonstration, refine LLM architecture with an action head, and train a vision-language-action (VLA) model at scale. However, we argue that coding agents have the potential to realize generalist embodied manipulation. All they need is a simple yet effective robot harness. We present RoboHarness: a robotic harness that gives LLM agents a visual-geometric control panel so that they can directly understand and invoke embodied tasks. With RoboHarness, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next outperforms state-of-the-art VLA models on BEHAVIOR Challenge 2025 tasks. The implementation will be released as open source.

translated_title: RoboHarness：一个简单的机器人操控框架超越VLA与世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的兴起为通用具身智能开辟了一条道路，同时也引出一个问题：LLM如何在物理世界中行动。一种直接的做法是训练模型生成动作：收集机器人动作数据与视频演示，在LLM架构中加入动作头，并大规模训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。然而，我们认为编码智能体有潜力实现通用具身操作，它们所需的只是一个简单而有效的机器人操控框架。我们提出了RoboHarness：一个为LLM智能体提供视觉-几何控制面板的机器人框架，使其能够直接理解并调用具身任务。借助RoboHarness，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next在BEHAVIOR Challenge 2025任务上超越了最先进的VLA模型。相关实现将以开源形式发布。
tldr: RoboHarness为一个简单的机器人操控框架，赋予LLM智能体视觉-几何控制面板，使其无需专门训练VLA模型即可直接理解并调用具身任务，并在BEHAVIOR Challenge 2025上超越最先进的VLA模型。
en_tdlr: RoboHarness is a simple robotic harness that equips LLM agents with a visual-geometric control panel, enabling them to directly understand and invoke embodied tasks and outperform state-of-the-art VLA models on BEHAVIOR Challenge 2025.
